title: Croatian Burger Buns with Aerated Twist
description: A twist on traditional burger buns, infused with aerated flavors and a touch of Croatian spice. Serve with a juicy burger for a satisfying meal.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, sugar, and yeast.
Add warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add aerated soda and mix until the dough comes together.
Add Croatian spices and unsalted butter, and mix until well combined.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide into 4 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and then flatten into a disk.
Place the buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
